steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Relax! I've got this. I promise you I won't drop the ball.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: God, just relax, nothing can go wrong...

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Hahaha, you're so endearing, Chief... I'm gonna be fine...

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Blargh...

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Are you okay?

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: ...I have to go again...
The whole response team are staring at the tiny public bathroom. It is an awkward atmosphere.

steps.speaker: Mission Operative
steps.content: You sure everything is fine, Chief?
Fine is hardly the right word for the current situation.
The several dozen members of the response team are gathered outside the tiny bathroom.
The corner of Che's mouth twitches involuntarily. Veins pop out on K.K.'s forehead. And the others are feeling too awkward to say anything.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: It's getting dark.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: What about... you go on ahead without me...

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: I'll catch up with you... Blargh...
Bai Yi's voice issues from inside the bathroom.

steps.speaker: Cinnabar
steps.content: Chief, I suggest we send a small team to do a recon. Once we've attained some information about the enemy, the main force can then mount an attack.

steps.speaker: Mission Operative
steps.content: As for Bai Yi, well, S-class Sinners are an important asset in a battle... While we're doing the recon, that's an opportunity for her to take a break.

steps.speaker: Mission Operative
steps.content: This way, we'll have a better chance of success when we go in and make arrests, that is, if she's already back on her feet by then.
There is a murmur of general agreement in the crowd.
You ponder for a moment: The modus operandi of this elite MBCC response team might not work well in a place like Syndicate. It's probably not a good idea to assign them to do the recon.
Then the right persons for the job are there with you.
K.K., Che, we three go in. The rest of you stay put for further instructions.

steps.speaker: Mission Operative
steps.content: Copy that.
The three of you cross ██ Street. It was one of the most vibrant areas in Syndicate. Now, the buildings here have long been in bad repair, paint peeling off the walls.
The street is largely deserted. The few people around are elderly. Barely any youth is in sight.
You frown at this sorry sight.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Never mind about Bai Yi. She always does that.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: You'll be used to it when you get more familiar with her. My point is, don't get your hopes up when dealing with her... But I'm not saying don't have any hope at all either.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: Sorry to interrupt, but I don't think the Chief was thinking about our boss.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: You should worry about yourself. You've attracted some attention.
You glance in the direction Che is looking. An elderly woman is staring at you three, neck craned, eyes narrowed. K.K. looks away, in an effort to avoid being recognized.
But it seems to backfire. The woman appears to have confirmed your identies and is now hurrying over, a surprised smile on her face.

steps.speaker: Elderly Woman
steps.content: If it isn't you, K.K.! You're finally back!

steps.speaker: Elderly Woman
steps.content: You girl. Always sneak out on your own without a word. You've worried us sick.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: ...I'm fine.

steps.speaker: Elderly Woman
steps.content: Of course you're fine. It's not like someone can give you trouble. A lot has happened here in your absence though.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Like what?

steps.speaker: Elderly Woman
steps.content: Plenty of things. Here is one: the toilet over at Mr. Li's has been clogged for almost a month. We are out of our depth. You are the one who has been doing these things for us.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: I'm... er... busy today...

steps.speaker: Elderly Woman
steps.content: Remember to drop by Mr. Li's house tomorrow then. See? I always send jobs your way.

steps.speaker: Elderly Woman
steps.content: And... who are you?
The woman looks you up and down.

steps.speaker: Elderly Woman
steps.content: Oh, a cop, I guess, by the look of it.
Do I really look like a cop to you?

steps.speaker: Elderly Woman
steps.content: Come on, don't play coy with me. Nothing escapes my eye.

steps.speaker: Elderly Woman
steps.content: Just as well. I told you long ago not to work for your last employer. She dumped everything on you. She's despicable.

steps.speaker: Elderly Woman
steps.content: And you, you yellow-haired brat, where have you been all day? Running like a bat out of hell whenever I ask you to do something.
Che is impervious to the woman's reprimand, looking up at the sky whistling.

steps.speaker: Elderly Woman
steps.content: I heard that your last employer has just set up a company or something and is fighting for territory with the gangs. Bah! Walking around like a millionaire; she still owes money to my shop.

steps.speaker: Elderly Woman
steps.content: It's good that you work for a cop now; it's much more stable. I'm happy for you.
Cough...

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Uh... I've got things to do. I have to go now. See you around.

steps.speaker: Elderly Woman
steps.content: Oh, okay. I'll get out of your hair.

steps.speaker: Elderly Woman
steps.content: Don't forget about Mr. Li's toilet.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: ...I'll be there in a couple of days.

You leave the enthusiastic woman. You turn a corner, then another, and finally find yourselves in sight of an old building, which is your destination—the headquarters of the fake Whitestone Industries.
In today's Syndicate, where most gangs have been broken up, the ferocious-looking guards standing in front of the gate stick out like a sore thumb.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Look at those guards. Sneaking in might not be possible.
Now that we've found the place, I can order the response team to attack.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: You don't want to alert them.
You're right. Maybe... we can find a way to take care of those guards.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: That's too much trouble. Let me handle this.
What are you gonna do? You sure you can pull it off?

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: Relax... I'm nothing like Bai Yi.
The moment Che steps out of the shadows, the guards point their guns at him.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Who are you?

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: Easy, bro, I'm just a messenger.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: A messenger? How did you manage to find this place?

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: First time here. This is 43 ██ Street, right?

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Yes. What are you doing here?

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: My boss found a new customer.
Che lowers his voice.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: You have some products for sale here. This guy is loaded. I hear it's urgent. A chance for you to fleece this customer good.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Who is your boss?

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: Mr. Jackal. He used to be part of the Carnivore gang. You must know him. He was here a few days ago.
The guards exchange a few hushed words.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Who is this Mr. Jackal?

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: I can't recall knowing a Mr. Jackal...

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: The name does sound like he belongs to the Carnivore gang though.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: He's quite fat, and he likes wearing leopard prints.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Does that ring a bell?

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Not really. But sounds a lot like our boss.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Birds of a feather...

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: I say screw it... He's here to buy our products; why don't we just let him in?

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Not so fast. Let me ask him something more.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Cough cough... Oh, Mr. Jackal, now I remember. You should've opened with that. Why isn't he here with you?

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: Ah, it's embarrassing. Yesterday, he took the customer to dinner, and ended up with diarrhea and couldn't stop vomiting. Now he's too weak to go out, while the customer is as good as new.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: That's why he sent this newbie here.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Where is the customer? Why are you here alone?

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: If I had come here with the customer without talking to you first, and you decided not to let us in, we might risk losing a customer.
The guards exchange glances, looking less tense now.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Mr. Jackal still hitting the bottle hard? Is he trying to drink himself to death?

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: You know what he's like. That's his vice. He has half a mind to stop paying us, just so he can have more cash for drinking.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: jojo

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Why didn't you leave?

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: Times are hard. The Carnivore gang is gone... You count yourself lucky if you're not starving in such times.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Yeah... Times are hard indeed.

steps.speaker: Guard Flunky A
steps.content: These employers in Syndicate, they're all the same. You can't find a half-decent one here.
The other guard chips in.

steps.speaker: Guard Flunky A
steps.content: Our boss is no different. We don't know how he got his hands on those Mania weapons. He should've kept a low profile at a time like this. It's like he wants the whole world to know his business.

steps.speaker: Guard Flunky B
steps.content: Exactly. I'm constantly worried about the FAC finding their way here. I can't even sleep well. If you ask me, this Mr. Bai can't be a native of Syndicate...

steps.speaker: Guard Flunky B
steps.content: I would've **** left long ago if it weren't for the fat paychecks.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Hey...
The guard in charge, seemingly worried that his men are talking too much, interrupts the conversation.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: You can bring the customer over, if you really are Mr. Jackal's guy. But we can allow three persons in at the most. Deadline for the pick-up is tomorrow, and it's final.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: Only three?

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Special times call for special measures. People have been drooling over our products.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Don't worry. Whitestone Industries is legit. We don't do things like kidnapping or blackmailing.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: ...Okay then. I trust you, bros. I'll bring the customer over now.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: You convinced them just by bullshitting them?

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: What else were they gonna do? They're running a business. They can't afford to be too paranoid, if they don't want to go bankrupt.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: ...Please tell me Bai Yi was wrong; you're not a mole, right?

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: Don't be ridiculous...

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: So here is our situation. They won't let too many of us in, but if there are too few of us inside, it might mean trouble later on. Going in or not... that's for you to decide.
What do you think?

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: Me? I think it wouldn't hurt to take a look. They sell Mania weapons; they're making big money, so I don't think they're gonna kidnap you for some ransom money.
K.K., what do you think?

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Like I said earlier, if we attack now, it'll alert them. This area is like a maze; if they run, we might not be able to catch them.
Let's go inside and take a look then.
The three of you, accompanied by the guards, enter the building.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Sorry, our boss is in the middle of something. He'll meet you later.

options: Ask the guard to show you around

choices.text: Ask the guard to show you around

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Will do. What do you want to see?
You are guided around Whitestone Industries' conference room, dormitories for employees, and workspace, which are all fitted out nicely, on a par with those in any small business in Eastside.
It's hard to believe that a Syndicate organization selling Mania weapons is as well equipped as a decent company.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: Wow, very impressive. It's as well equipped as Yagyu's building, if not better.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: All just a fuss. Now you understand why they say Mr. Bai is from Eastside.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: What really matters here are these babies; all the other stuff is just for show.
You realize what the guard is indicating. Each person in the building is holding a Mania weapon, a fact that is hard to ignore.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: This is the employee breakroom. That is the reception room. Our boss is not done yet. Why don't you go inside and relax for a bit?
As the guard is talking, Che gives you a meaningful look.

options: Excuse me, could you tell me where the bathroom is?

choices.text: Excuse me, could you tell me where the bathroom is?

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Of course, out the door, then turn right.
Thank you.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: I hear you drank some Mr. Jackal under the table yesterday. You're quite slim. You don't strike me as someone who can hold the liquor.
I was lucky... I was wasted too.
Under the guard's admiring gaze, you quickly leave for the bathroom.
Having shaken off the guard temporarily, you loosen up a little. Looking at your reflection in the mirror over the sink, you wipe the sweat from your temples.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: I didn't expect them to have so many Mania weapons. Tricky... We might not have the manpower to take it down, I'm afraid.
During your tour around the building, you've noticed that almost every guard inside is armed with a Mania weapon.
The number of Mania weapons in this building is astounding. It's even more impressive when you consider that the overall number has dramatically decreased in the past few months.
Indeed...
We'd better not attack this time, just to be on the safe side. We'll bring more Sinners with us next time.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: Good idea. We could have been in great trouble if we hadn't done the recon.
Hmm...
When the boss comes out, we'll go through the motions and then leave. Meet the boss and get out, and that's it.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Hi, I...
The unexpected voice startles you and Che. It belongs to K.K., who has poked her head in.
Che takes a glance at the sign on the door. It's the men's room all right. He runs a palm over his face.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: What are you doing here? Next time, say something to identify yourself before you come into a room.
K.K. looks embarrassed.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: I drank too much water... The toilet next door is clogged up.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: Be quick then.
Without saying another word, K.K. opens the door to one of the stalls and walks in.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: ...There's no lock on the door.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: They perked up the other rooms, and they slacked off on the bathroom. It's so confusing.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: Don't worry. We'll keep watch for you.
You stay outside the door for a moment, and then, a funky smell wafts out.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: What's that oniony smell? K.K., what did you eat yesterday?

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: Wait a second. Are you doing a number two?

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: No! It isn't me!
K.K.'s angry denial issues from inside the stall, followed by the sound of the toilet flushing.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: If it's not you, who was it then? The Chief?
K.K. comes out of the stall, her face all twisted. Apparently, the smell inside the stall must've been stronger.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: It's you!

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: Nonsense. You don't know what kind of person I am? I would own up to it if it was me.
Then it could only be...
The three of you turn your heads slowly in the same direction, at the only other stall in the bathroom.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: Gosh, s-someone is in there?

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: You guys didn't check?
No...

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: So, the guy in there heard everything you just said?

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: Yes, unless whoever is in there is deaf...

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: They have too many Mania weapons, and you don't have enough people.
During your tour around the building, you've noticed that almost every guard inside is armed with a Mania weapon.
The number of Mania weapons in this building is astounding. It's even more impressive when you consider that the overall number has dramatically decreased in the past few months.
Indeed...
We'd better not attack this time, just to be on the safe side. We'll bring more Sinners with us next time.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Yes, we should leave nothing to chance.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: Are you done? Can I come in?
The unexpected voice startles you and K.K.
K.K. takes a glance at the sign on the door. It's the ladies' room all right. She runs a palm over her face.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Are you a pervert...
Che couldn't care less about the abuse directed at him.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: The toilet next door is clogged up... let me use the bathroom.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: ...Be quick about it.
Without saying another word, Che opens the door to one of the stalls and walks in.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: There's no lock on the door...

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: They perked up the other rooms, and they slacked off on the bathroom. It's so confusing.
Che complains for a bit, and then, a funky smell wafts out.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Told you to cut down on garlic.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: I did.
From the stall comes the sound of the toilet flushing, and then Che comes out, looking confused.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: If it's not you, who was it then? The Chief?
Seized by an uneasy sense of foreboding, the three of you turn your heads slowly in the same direction, at the only other stall in the bathroom.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: You guys didn't check?

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Does that mean... the person in there heard everything we just said?
For a moment, the air seems to become solid.
As if to confirm your suspicions, a loud plop comes out of the stall in question.
K.K. rushes over and yanks the door open. Sitting on the toilet is a fat man with a horrified look on his face; he is wearing a leopard print and holding a newspaper.

steps.speaker: Fat Man
steps.content: Help!! Cops in here!!
A spark of menace glinting in her eyes, K.K. produces her truncheon from behind her back.
Che grabs her wrist.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: Don't do anything stupid! No one cares if he is alive or dead. It won't make any difference even if you kill him. Let's get out of here!
K.K. frowns, and then lands a blow on his head with her truncheon. He is knocked out and goes limp, still seated on the toilet.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: ...Run.
The three of you rush out of the bathroom, only to be confronted with a few armed guards.
Che and K.K. exchange quick glances and swing into action, each taking care of one side. In only a few seconds, they got rid of the guards.
But you're still too late. The other guards have arrived to block your way out.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: Haha... They are quick.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: The usual?

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: Fine with me.
They play a game of rock-paper-scissors right in front of you. And unsurprisingly, K.K. loses again.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: I never win in this game...

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: Don't play rock next time.
K.K. tightens her grip on the truncheon, facing the swarm of enemies.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Win or lose... doesn't make much of a difference now, I guess.
Apparently, she's staying behind so that you and Che can retreat.
I've informed the response team. You only have to stick it out until they get here...

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Cut the crap.
K.K. dashes into oncoming heavy fire and cracks open the wall of guards. She loses balance and falls onto the ground.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Go!
Before you can say anything, Che tugs you along behind him, running down the path cleared by K.K.'s attack.
You and Che come down the stairs. Che pokes his head into the doorway to the stairwell, but retracts it immediately when bullets come flying in.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: ...I never thought I would get myself in such a predicament.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: I should've let K.K. win. That way, I wouldn't be in so much trouble.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: Don't give me that look. We suggested you coming in here. No reason to ask you to pay the price.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: One more thing... When you come back with your men, save K.K. first.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Give **** up!

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: We've captured the one upstairs. Now, be smart and surrender.
Che makes no response. Instead, he throws a short knife at the guard.

steps.speaker: Guard Flunky A
steps.content: My hand, my ******* hand!

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: These ***** cops are a bunch of lunatics. Take them down!
A confusion of footfalls can be heard as the guards troop in. Che slams the door by the stairwell, and the two at the front are knocked over.
Half a dozen men throw themselves on Che, immobilizing him under them.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: W-window!
Despite being in a dire situation, Che makes an effort to tell you to escape through the window.

options: Break the window and jump out

choices.text: Break the window and jump out

steps.content: The glass shatters, and you jump out.
It's a jump of about three or four meters. Your vision goes blurry from the impact, and your face has been lacerated by shards of glass.
But you waste no time in escaping the premises.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Don't let that rat run away!
After escaping the building, you run and run, but can't seem to shake off your pursuers.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Stop running!

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: F*** me! The skinny little rat can run.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Open fire! Don't let him get away, he's a cop!
steps.female_content: Open fire! Don't let her get away, she's a cop!

steps.content: Bullets whizz past you. You continue running, legs pumping.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: ****! What are you aiming at?

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: You do it, Mr. Marksman.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Stop it. Get rid of him. Quick!
steps.female_content: Stop it. Get rid of her. Quick!

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Hold on. Did you **** hear it?
You hear it too. It is getting closer, the sound of an engine.
A motorcycle turns the corner and comes into sight, leaning dangerously close to the ground.
The driver is none other than Bai Yi. She reaches out a hand, speeding in your direction.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Hop on!
You don't have a chance to hop on. Bai Yi has turned the corner at such a high speed that she is thrown off the vehicle and smashes into you.
The motorcycle races toward the pursuers and hits them head-on.
Boom—
An impressive explosion ensues, lighting up the street.
Bai Yi gets off you.
K.K. and Che... they... they got caught...

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: I know.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: Chief, I need your help.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: I want to get them out.
Bai Yi looks at you with a strange look on her face.
You didn't have to ask. I will not leave them there.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: That's all I need to hear... Ow...
Bai Yi clamps a hand on the head where it's been hit.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: That hurts...
